bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education; waiving certain graduation requirements for international baccalaureate program students; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120B.024, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120B.024, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 3.+]

[+Waiver for international baccalaureate program students.+]

[+(a) Starting in the 2026-2027 school year, upon receiving a student's application signed by the student's parent or guardian, a school district or charter school must declare that a student meets the graduation credit requirements under subdivision 1 if the district or charter school determines that the student: +]

[+(1) is on track by the beginning of grade 11 to meet the requirements of an international baccalaureate diploma program or an international baccalaureate career-related program; and +]

[+(2) would be precluded from participating in the international baccalaureate diploma program or international baccalaureate career-related program if the student were required to complete a credit to be waived. +]

[+(b) A district or charter school may revoke the waiver for a student who is not on track at the beginning of grade 12 to meet the requirements of an international baccalaureate diploma program or an international baccalaureate career-related program. A student whose waiver is revoked must complete the credit requirements under subdivision 1. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2026. +]

Section 1.

(1) is on track by the beginning of grade 11 to meet the requirements of an international baccalaureate diploma program or an international baccalaureate career-related program; and

(2) would be precluded from participating in the international baccalaureate diploma program or international baccalaureate career-related program if the student were required to complete a credit to be waived.

(b) A district or charter school may revoke the waiver for a student who is not on track at the beginning of grade 12 to meet the requirements of an international baccalaureate diploma program or an international baccalaureate career-related program. A student whose waiver is revoked must complete the credit requirements under subdivision 1.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2026.
